name: Speechmatics
description: Transcribe audio files and live streams, and give voice agents turn-based speech-to-text with speaker labels and turn detection, through REST and WebSocket APIs, for voice app builders.

skills.name: Transcribe Files
skills.description: Transcribes pre-recorded audio and video files through the Batch API, with speaker diarization and language identification.

skills.name: Transcribe Live Audio
skills.description: Transcribes streaming audio to text in real time over a WebSocket connection, with real-time speaker diarization.

skills.name: Agent STT
skills.description: Streams a conversation in and returns speaker-labelled, turn-based transcripts with turn detection, ready to pass to an LLM.

skills.name: Text to Speech
skills.description: Converts text to speech with Speechmatics voices through the text-to-speech API, for voice agents and apps.

skills.name: Translate Audio
skills.description: Translates the speech in your audio into multiple languages with a single API call alongside the transcript.
